verdict.rationale: Community posts link an independent Geekbench comparison where the M4 Max beats a 13900K, and note a competing chip is "nowhere near" on single-CPU performance. That points to leading single-thread performance, but the evidence is thin and anecdotal. One commenter questions whether Geekbench submissions are verified; this is general skepticism rather than a concrete counter-result. Apple's own docs give only workload-level speedup claims, not single-thread figures. Missing for 10: first-party single-core performance data, rigorous independent single-thread benchmark reviews, and evidence on interactive responsiveness or latency.

support.subject: As a power-user, everyday interactive work feels instant — leading single-thread performance shown in independent benchmarks, not just a peak-GHz number on a slide

citations.quote: Wild. It absolutely shits on my 13900K - https://browser.geekbench.com/v6/cpu/compare/7692643?baseline=8593555
